title: Tiny handmade hedgehog miniature for dollhouse in 1:12 scale 2
description: An adorable miniature hedgehog, entirely handcrafted and carefully detailed. The tiny figure was sculpted, textured, and painted by hand, with realistic spines and delicate facial features. Perfect for collectors, dollhouse scenes, woodland dioramas, fairy gardens, miniature displays, and creative photography. This little hedgehog will bring a sweet and lively touch to any miniature setting. Not suitable for children.
